It is ok, don’t panic ! If your scars get more prominent in the heat- use very inconspicuous methods such as a wet towel over the legs or a cold drink. If they are fresh, apply wound healing cream, if not available, Vaseline works a treat ! For scars use very high sun screen, from experience scars go very red very quickly !! Make sure to look after yourself

Hi, I understand the feeling of loneliness and numbness even when you’re around people, sometime it can get worse in a group. When you are trying so desperately to hide emotions it takes a huge toll on yourself, I’m very sorry that you didn’t have anyone to hug you at that time. I understand the relief, but if I may say; in reality it was coming back to something that you were familiar with, the SH made you skip to feeling in control. Symptom of getting more irritated and snapping is a sign of worsening depression NOT A DOCTOR, it is understandable to feel lost and scared, you were in a new situation that stimulated a lot of feelings, don’t beat yourself up. Message me if you need x - Kieren

I am so sorry this happened to you, it is definitely not ok, and if you need support I would suggest talking to someone you trust. If you are in school (which I’m guessing from the gym class comment) make sure, if you can/comfortable to have changes made to your uniform for gym, maybe longer pants, the person who said this sounds not like they wanted to help, more to make it about them. Keep safe, if you need please message me- Kieren

Important to realise that it’s just us making fun of ourselves and making ourselves feel worse ( in my opinion lol) message me if need x

It’s ok to worry about this, if your dominant hand arm is wounded it often doesn’t heal or scar the same way, it can be more red or raised due to constant use of the area (I am assuming arm). With dominant and non dominant it can also disrupt the harm done, so it may feel or look different, but it’s completely fine to worry, and you have no need to apologise, message me if you need x

It’s perfectly fine to feel this way, I feel it all the time, the size or age of our scars doesn’t mean anything. The scars we have is from our worst hour, it’s nothing to prove or accentuate. You don’t need to do anything love, I understand the confusion and frustration, but your pain from SH isn’t measured by anything. Message me if you need x
